'''Marc Castellani''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Helmond tournament]] on 16 April 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit with Uh-Oh!]], according to Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d549">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-netherlands-helmond-16-04-2000d549/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
